The biggest healthcare and pharmaceutical distributor in the world by total revenue is [McKesson Corporation](https://www.mckesson.com/), bringing in hundreds of billions of dollars annually. It is closely followed by other massive global distributors like Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen) and Cardinal Health. [](https://finance.yahoo.com/research-hub/screener/sec-ind_ind-largest-equities_medical-distribution/)

- **McKesson Corporation**: The largest US-based healthcare distributor, providing pharmaceuticals, medical supplies, and health information technology.

- **Cencora**: A massive global pharmaceutical distributor handling a huge portion of the United States' drug supply.

- **Cardinal Health**: A global giant providing pharmaceuticals, medical-surgical products, and lab supplies.

- **Henry Schein**

: A leading worldwide distributor specifically focused on dental and medical office supplies.
